summary: Restored proposal, functionality document, and all six cached canonical evidence reads into this attempt. Reconciled all seven changes and twelve non-retain dispositions. The prior validation failure was a mistyped revision in the review citation, not in the input proposal; corrected review locators use c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3. Acceptance and five compiled-evidence deferrals remain warranted; unchanged inherited knowledge retained.

proposed_facts.reason: The wrapper iterates items sharing a nonzero identifier and otherwise delegates locally. The proposed descriptive name distinguishes it from FA2C and addresses the rendered collision.
The initializer and explicit Vec3 read establish a positive-Z axis consumed by four rotation calls; no compiled placement is asserted.
The consumer rotates four cardinal ECB points and reconstructs extrema, establishing an axis role rather than quaternion-orientation use.

The signature, mutable offsets, model-rotation caller, and repeated normalization are explicit. Large finite f32 values can fail to progress; the removed universal finite-input guarantee was unsupported.
The guarded setter overwrites only geometry. The shell caller copies saved geometry, assigns endpoint Y to 6.0f, doubles scale conditionally, and installs slot zero.
The setter leaves state and attachment unchanged, and the shell example correctly describes assignment rather than an additive rise.

Initialization supplies the attachment and local offset; the updater tests item->xB68 directly and transforms into xB84. The caller updates first, then forwards the record base and xB68 to each dynamic-bone simulation. Its separate dynamicBonesNum snapshot does not establish an xB68 snapshot.

contradictions.reason: The duplicate registration name obscures a real local-helper versus shared-item-group-wrapper distinction; accept the wrapper rename.
The no-consumer and fixed-orientation explanations conflict with the explicit positive-Z Vec3 axis consumer; accept both source-level corrections without inferring section placement.
Repeated floating-point addition/subtraction cannot guarantee progress for every finite magnitude; accept the bounded numerical explanation.
Both additive shell-endpoint descriptions are contradicted by assignment to 6.0f; accept the data-flow and gameplay corrections.
Accept the .data deferral: the source establishes an s32[17] effect table, not mixed compiled section composition or placement.
Accept the three .sdata2 materialization/composition deferrals: arithmetic and a conditional ordering helper do not prove compiler-emitted pools or section-specific loads.

Accept the remaining section-fact deferral. The distance sentinel does not prove compiled placement, and the immediate return on accepted overlap precludes describing the Catch scan as a complete nearest-target search. The functionality document preserves this distinction.

The updater does not explicitly snapshot xB68. Accept the correction while retaining initialization, transform, and downstream simulation ordering. The prior malformed review citation is corrected here; the input proposal citation was already valid.

unresolved: Five compiled-section fact deferrals remain accepted pending revision-matched object/map evidence; source declarations and ordering helpers do not establish composition or placement.
Header shadowed bindings for it_8027236C and it_802723FC remain a renderer issue, not grounds for unsupported semantic changes.

Inherited numeric-state ambiguities, exceptional resolver inputs, angle-normalization limitations, and cross-file ownership/lifetime distinctions remain preserved. Acceptance covers all proposed changes and examined contradictions, not a fresh independent audit of every retained fact or link.

Imported prior exception: explicit Vec3 consumer contradicts no-consumer claim.
Imported prior exception: repeated floating-point normalization need not progress for very large finite angles; any finite magnitude is unsupported.
Shell caller assigns a_offset.y = 6.0f, not an additive raise by six units.
Clarify endpoint is set to local Y=6 rather than increased by six.
Source proves s32[17], not mixed compiled section composition or placement. No compiled artifacts supplied.
Useful established role is positive-Z axis for ECB rotations, not an unconsumed fixed orientation; compiled placement is not inferred.
